narrative.overview:
Mi Alma reads as a contemporary agency portfolio played completely straight: a structured grid, alternating near-black and white sections, large real photography and video, and a single restrained pink accent. There is no theme, no metaphor, no decoration standing in for content. The proof is the clients' own Instagram feeds, shown at legible size inside iPhone frames, and every other device on the page stays quiet so those feeds and the shooting photos carry the weight.

The system is convention executed at full craft. Headings are large and tightly tracked, body text is calm and generous, dividers are hairlines, and corners follow a strict hierarchy (panels, then cards and images, then inputs, then pills). Density is low: sections breathe on a clamped 80 to 140px rhythm and grids use a narrow 12px gap so groups of cards and photos read as one block.

The world explicitly rejects themed or illustrative treatments (the user's words: "deve essere una cosa seria. ben strutturata, non a caso"). Seriousness comes from structure, real imagery and type, not from props.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black and white grounds alternating section by section, with a warm mist for quiet bands.
One accent (Mi Alma pink) on primary buttons, small markers and at most one solid CTA field per page.
General Sans headings with tight negative tracking over Switzer text.
Inset rounded panels for the hero and CTA, floating 12px off the viewport edge.
Real client feeds in iPhone mockups as the signature component.
Hairline dividers and flat surfaces; shadow only on the phone and the floating WhatsApp button.

rules.name: The One Pink Rule
rules.body: Pink is the only accent. It marks primary actions and small markers; it fills a large surface only once per page, as the accent CTA field. Never introduce a second brand hue.

rules.name: The Green Stays Put Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green appears only on the floating WhatsApp button. WhatsApp links elsewhere use the normal button vocabulary (light or accent).

rules.name: The Alternation Rule
rules.body: Sections alternate grounds (white, Studio Black, white, mist) so the page reads as a sequence of clear blocks. Two dark sections are never stacked.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Every heading uses General Sans 500 with negative tracking (-0.01 to -0.04em, tighter as size grows) and `text-wrap: balance`. Headings are never uppercase and never letter-spaced open.

rules.name: The Heading Then Lead Rule
rules.body: A section opens with a heading and, beside or below it, a muted lead. There is no small label above the heading.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, steps and rows never carry shadows. Separation is a ground change or a 1px hairline.

dos: Do keep pink to primary buttons, small markers (dots, numbers, checks, focus) and at most one solid CTA field per page.
Do alternate white, Studio Black and mist sections so the page reads as clear blocks.
Do follow the radius hierarchy: 24px panels, 16px cards and images, 10px inputs, pill buttons.
Do separate with 1px hairlines and ground changes; keep surfaces flat.
Do set headings in General Sans 500 with negative tracking and pair them with a muted lead.
Do use real client feeds, shooting photos and video; greyscale supporting photography so client colour stands out.
Do keep motion to the load-time hero rise and hover states, and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce a themed or illustrative world, props or metaphors; the user rejected that ("sembra un cartone animato").
Don't add a second accent colour or use WhatsApp green outside the floating button.
Don't put shadows on cards, panels or rows.
Don't place small labels or eyebrows above headings.
Don't use stock imagery, invented stats, logos, testimonials or prices.
Don't add scroll-triggered reveals or decorative animation.
Don't stack two accent CTA fields or two dark sections back to back.
